requirements.text: * Cloud Infrastructure, preferably AWS and GCP
* Containerization and Orchestration, notably Helm, ArgoCD, Istio, KEDA, on EKS/GKE
* Monitoring and Logging utilties, preferably DataDog or some mix of Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, Splunk
* CI/CD Tools, preferably Jenkins and GitHub Actions
* Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform
* Configuration Management, preferably ansible
You have strong expertise with the following:
* CLI Scripting, especially to enhance all of the above
* A passion for learning new tools as the ecosystem evolves and helping others adapt
* Computer-related BS or MS degree or other technical discipline
* Experience with On-Call rotations, incident response and postmortems
* MySQL or MariaDB or other Basic SQL Skills (especially Performance Tuning)
* Experience building compliant solutions for international markets
* History of building and maintaining systems at large scale
* A history of documenting projects upon completion and reviewing and updating regularly
